annotations.title: Rental Fapiao Tax Surcharge vs IIT Deduction ROI Analyzer

description: Evaluate whether paying a landlord surcharge to obtain official housing VAT invoices generates positive after-tax savings at your marginal rate.

marginalRate.description: Employee top applicable IIT decimal rate between 0.03 and 0.45 (e.g., 0.30 for 30%).

monthlyRentRMB.description: Contractual monthly apartment rent in RMB before any landlord invoice markup.

surchargeRatePct.description: Percentage fee demanded by the landlord or agent to issue official tax bureau Fapiao (e.g., 5).
